scope: Combined source must be compared with the base within the native job, never by summing earlier experiment gains. C job CPU is independent. No cross-job absolute timing comparison.

limits: VP8 remains 13.026% slower than original ASM on this EPYC 9V45 run, all six pairs slower 11.044–14.081%.
Quant counts 1/2 medians regress 5.500%/0.968% versus base with mixed paired signs.
VP9 720p observed 4.398% faster versus base, all six pairs; no separate VP9 arithmetic change is attributed to this control.
Independent jobs on the same CPU model are not the same hardware instance. Do not compare C-job absolute times to native-job times.

profile_diagnostics.contract: One 120-frame profile per variant, 10 ms CPU samples; nested cumulative values are not additive and are not precise per-call comparisons.
profile_diagnostics.missing_direct_kernel: Stats/VarianceBlock16x16 is live but not present as a direct matched kernel in this 80-case matrix.

timing_contract.govpx: sum of EncodeInto call durations; input construction, warmup and allocation sampling excluded
timing_contract.libvpx: vpxenc cumulative vpx_codec_encode timer; subprocess/file wall timing reported separately
timing_contract.libvpx_latency: legacy helper latency fields repeat the mean, not measured latency quantiles; not used here
timing_contract.order: three govpx-first and three reference-first runs per case
timing_contract.quality: separate post-timing decode/PSNR/SSIM pass, same inputs and flags
timing_contract.scope: synthetic same-input/controls comparison; differing output/quality/drop work is reported, not assumed equivalent

optimized_c.adaptive_limit: C adaptive VP8 timed payloads differ across samples; its separate quality pass does not describe every timed output. Use fixed-8 matched measured quality/payload/counts for strongest equivalent-work comparison; no bitstream-identity assertion.
